events.name: Miners' strike
events.text: The miners' union has called a strike across the coalfields. Coal will be scarce.

events.name: Coal glut
events.text: New seams and cheap imports are flooding the coal market.

events.name: Ore shipping disrupted
events.text: Storms and a dockers' dispute are holding up iron ore cargoes.

events.name: Building boom
events.text: Towns are growing fast and builders cannot get enough stone, steel or tools.

events.name: Railway boom
events.text: Companies are racing to lay new lines. Rails and steel are in demand.

events.name: Electrification
events.text: Cities are wiring up. Copper is wanted everywhere.

events.name: Shipbuilding programme
events.text: The navy and the shipping lines have placed large orders.

events.name: Steel dumping
events.text: Foreign mills are selling steel below cost to win customers.

events.name: Recession
events.text: Trade has slumped and customers are cancelling orders for finished goods.

events.name: Rearmament
events.text: The army depots are stocking up on steel, tools and coal.
